name: Urban Company

SDE-1.dsaDepth: Heavy — 2 to 3 Medium–Hard DSA problems in the OA, then LLD-focused interviews
rounds: Pre-placement talk (campus drives), then an offline/online coding test: 2–3 medium–hard DSA problems in 90 minutes
Interview 1 (LLD): e.g. a task manager or LRU-cache-style design, taken by an SDE-2
Interview 2 (LLD or DP): a second design round or a DP-focused coding round, sometimes taken by an engineering manager
extraTopics: Low-level design (OOP, appropriate data structures) over pure algorithms
SDE-1.notes: Some loops run only 2 rounds (1 DSA-heavy OA + 1 LLD); others run 4.

ladder.title: SDE-2, Engineering Manager and beyond
ladder.notes: SDE-2s and Engineering Managers appear as interviewers in reports
